svg.title: Morphy's Opera Game, 1858
svg.desc: A chessboard replaying Paul Morphy's Opera Game: seventeen moves ending in a queen sacrifice and mate.

svg.text: MORPHY vs DUKE OF BRUNSWICK & COUNT ISOUARD
both rooks and the queen given away
mate delivered by the only two pieces left on the board
